$comment: RoleCall pipeline status — single source of truth. Drives kanban columns, status badges, filters, and the DB status enum. `id` is the stable machine value (use in the database); `label` is display text. `dot` = solid indicator color; `badgeBg`/`badgeFg` = soft-tinted pill. `group` splits active pipeline from closed outcomes.
$storage: Store a job's status as its `id` in a database ENUM column whose allowed values are exactly the `id`s below. Do NOT store `label`, colors, or `group` — resolve those in the UI from this file at render time. Changing the pipeline (adding/removing/renaming a status) means editing this file AND running a DB enum migration. Changing only colors needs no migration.
$palette: Active stages progress COOL → WARM in pipeline order — navy, blue, teal, lime, coral — so the band reads as a gradient of momentum and Offer lands on the brand coral. Source: Claude Design 'RoleCall' project, rolecall-new/ handoff (Oct 2026). Closed statuses were not in that handoff; they were chosen here to sit quietly in the navy family. Every badgeFg/badgeBg pair is ≥5.5:1.
